description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the HomePageDao data access object in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains setup procedures and multiple test cases verifying the retrieval and ordering of home pages and module default pages based on user roles and priorities.

classes.name: HomePageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for HomePageDao, testing retrieval of home pages and default pages based on user roles and priorities

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating relevant tables, loading fixtures, and instantiating HomePageDao.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of home pages in correct priority order for a single user role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of home pages when multiple roles are assigned.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Checks behavior when no home pages match the provided role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Checks behavior when role list is empty.

methods.name: compareHomePages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual home page entities.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of module default pages in priority order for a single role.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of module default pages for multiple roles.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Checks behavior when no module default pages match the criteria.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Checks behavior when role list is empty for module default pages.

methods.name: compareModuleDefaultPages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual module default page entities.
